name: L&K Engineering (Suzhou) Co.,Ltd.
summary: L&K Engineering (Suzhou) Co.,Ltd., established in Suzhou, China, in 2002, is a specialist provider of cleanroom engineering services throughout China. The company extends its expert technical solutions to a diverse range of sectors, including semiconductor manufacturing, optoelectronics, solar energy, biopharmaceuticals, food processing, healthcare facilities, and commercial properties. It operates as a subsidiary of L&K Engineering Co., Ltd.
